usage: cloudgoat.py help
cloudgoat: error: unrecognized arguments: --usage

--alter.help: Alter existing table to add any missing columns

--analyze.help: Analyze resulting tables and output results

--arrays.help: Output rows as arrays instead of objects

--attach.help: Additional databases to attach - specify alias and filepath

--business-days.help: add NUM business days to date(s)

--columns.help: Include list of columns for each view

--create-triggers.help: Create triggers to update the FTS tables when the parent table changes.

--default.help: Default value that should be set for a column

--delimiter.help: Delimiter to use for CSV files

--detect-types.help: Detect types for columns in CSV/TSV data

--dry-run.help: Show results of running this against first 10 rows

--encoding.help: Character encoding for input, defaults to utf-8

--fk.help: Column, other table, other column to set as a foreign key

--fk-col.help: Referenced column on that foreign key table - if omitted will automatically use the primary key

--fk-column.help: Name of the foreign key column to add to the table

--holiday-file.help: holidays to include from a file

--json-cols.help: Detect JSON cols and output them as JSON, not escaped strings

--limit.help: Number of rows to return - defaults to everything

--multi.help: Populate columns for keys in returned dictionary

--no-detect-types.help: Treat all CSV/TSV columns as TEXT

--no-headers.help: CSV file has no header row

--not-null.help: Columns that should be created as NOT NULL

--not-null-false.help: Remove NOT NULL from this column

--output.help: Optional separate column to populate with the output

--output-type.help: Column type to use for the output column

--pk.help: Columns to use as the primary key, e.g. id

--pk-none.help: Remove primary key (convert to rowid table)

--quote.help: Apply FTS quoting rules to search term

--quotechar.help: Quote character to use for CSV/TSV

--raw.help: Raw output, first column of first row

--rename.help: Rename this column in extracted table

--replace.help: Replace files with matching primary key

--schema.help: Show SQL schema for in-memory database

--text.help: Store file content as TEXT, not BLOB

--truncate.help: Truncate table before inserting records, if table already exists

--type.help: Change column type to INTEGER, TEXT, FLOAT or BLOB

--upsert.help: Upsert files with matching primary key
